headline: Opendatabot: 88% of Profits Fall to 10 Banks in the Country
summary: Ukrainian banks earned over UAH 108.5 billion in profit in the first half of the year, up 9% year on year. Opendatabot data show 10 banks account for 88% of profits.
why: Banks are central to Ukraine's financial system, and profit concentration shows how the sector's earnings are distributed. Investors track bank profitability as an indicator of financial health.
